narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Only three and five work, because one and fifteen are not real jump sizes.
<bookmark mark='one'/>But jumps of one land on every stone, so they reach fifteen and thirty.
<bookmark mark='fifteen'/>Jumps of fifteen land on fifteen and then on thirty, so they work too.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Both of those are real jump sizes, so Chintu's list is missing two.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>List the factors of the smaller number, then check each one on the larger number.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Treasures sit on four and on eight. Which jump sizes can reach both?
